prompt: We're adding a Card component. Give it a stylesheet that reuses the same brand color and spacing variables the Button component uses, and make sure it's part of the main build.
expected_output: A new partial for Card (for example styles/components/_card.scss) loads the shared variables with @use and a namespace instead of @import; main.scss, which already loads every partial through @use, gains a @use (or @forward) for the new partial and no @import; the existing Button and base partials are left alone.

expectations.text: A stylesheet for the Card component exists
The new component style loads shared code with @use
The new component style does not use @import
main.scss loads the new partial through the module system
main.scss stays on the module system
The existing Button partial is left alone rather than migrated as a side effect
